name: IntuneShade CIS L1 baseline
source: CIS Microsoft 365 Foundations Benchmark v7.0.0 - Level 1 controls in scope for Entra ID and Intune (sections 1.1, 2.2.1, 4, 5)

tenantChecks.title: Privileged accounts are cloud-only
tenantChecks.rule: Collect all principals with an active or eligible assignment to a privileged role (roleDefinition.isPrivileged = true). For each user, read onPremisesSyncEnabled.
tenantChecks.expected: No privileged user has onPremisesSyncEnabled = true
tenantChecks.notes: Groups assigned to roles: expand transitive members (GET /v1.0/groups/{id}/transitiveMembers).

tenantChecks.title: Two or more break-glass accounts are set up correctly
tenantChecks.rule: Let the admin tag 2+ break-glass accounts in the UI (persist locally). Then auto-verify per tagged account: cloud-only, permanent active Global Administrator, excluded from every enabled CA policy except the one dedicated to them.
tenantChecks.expected: >= 2 tagged accounts and all sub-checks pass
tenantChecks.notes: Break-glass list is also input for all CA checks (allowed exclusions).

tenantChecks.title: Between two and four Global Administrators
tenantChecks.rule: Count distinct users holding Global Administrator (active + eligible, groups expanded).
tenantChecks.notes: Show active vs eligible separately; permanent active GA outside break-glass is a finding of its own.

tenantChecks.title: Admin accounts have no productivity licences
tenantChecks.rule: For each privileged user, inspect assigned servicePlans.
tenantChecks.expected: No privileged user has productivity workloads enabled (e.g. EXCHANGE_S_ENTERPRISE, SHAREPOINTENTERPRISE, TEAMS1); Entra ID P1/P2-only is fine
tenantChecks.notes: Unlicensed admin accounts = Pass.

tenantChecks.title: Break-glass sign-ins raise an alert
tenantChecks.rule: Cannot be read via Graph delegated with confidence (alerting lives in Sentinel / Defender / Log Analytics). Show as manual with evidence upload/notes.

tenantChecks.title: Devices without a compliance policy are non-compliant
tenantChecks.expected: secureByDefault = true (devices without compliance policy are Not compliant)
tenantChecks.notes: Co-managed tenants: compliance workload may sit with ConfigMgr; flag as info.

tenantChecks.title: Personal device enrollment is blocked
tenantChecks.rule: Find the default platform restriction (priority 0; @odata.type deviceEnrollmentPlatformRestrictionsConfiguration or the per-platform singlePlatformRestriction variants). For each platform check personalDeviceEnrollmentBlocked.
tenantChecks.expected: personalDeviceEnrollmentBlocked = true for every platform in the default restriction
tenantChecks.notes: Report custom (non-default) restrictions that re-allow personal devices as info.

tenantChecks.title: Per-user MFA is not used
tenantChecks.rule: Read perUserMfaState for users (sample or full scan with paging; expensive on large tenants).
tenantChecks.notes: Offer "quick scan" (admins only) and "full scan".

tenantChecks.title: Users cannot register applications
Users cannot create tenants
Entra admin center is restricted to admins
tenantChecks.notes: Fallback to manual if endpoint returns 403/404.

tenantChecks.title: Users cannot create security groups
Owners cannot manage group membership requests
tenantChecks.rule: No Graph property; portal Groups > General.
tenantChecks.expected: "Owners can manage group membership requests in My Groups" = No

tenantChecks.title: Device limit per user is 20 or less
Global admins are not local admins on joined devices
Registering users are not local admins
tenantChecks.notes: "All" registering users as local admin = Fail.

tenantChecks.title: Entra LAPS is enabled
tenantChecks.notes: Pair with the Intune LAPS policy check (endpoint security > account protection).

tenantChecks.title: Admin consent workflow is enabled
App password credentials expire within 180 days
tenantChecks.notes: Also list apps with secrets older than 180 days as info (GET /v1.0/applications?$select=displayName,passwordCredentials).

tenantChecks.title: Custom app passwords are blocked
App certificates expire within 180 days
Guest directory access is restricted
tenantChecks.expected: 10dae51f-b6af-4016-8d66-8c2a99b929b3 (limited) or 2af84b1e-32c8-42b7-82bc-daa82404023b (most restrictive); a0b1b346-4d3e-4e8b-98f8-753987be4970 (same as members) = Fail

tenantChecks.title: Password hash sync is enabled (hybrid)
tenantChecks.notes: Federated tenants: still recommend PHS as backup; show domain authenticationType (GET /v1.0/domains).

tenantChecks.title: MFA required for all privileged roles
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: enabled policy, includeRoles covers all privileged roles (or All users), all apps, grant mfa or authenticationStrength.
tenantChecks.notes: Group-scoped admin policies: verify every privileged user is member; list uncovered admins.

tenantChecks.title: MFA required for all users
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: enabled, includeUsers All, includeApplications All, grant mfa/authenticationStrength.
tenantChecks.expected: >= 1 matching policy; exclusions only break-glass / documented
tenantChecks.notes: Count and list excluded users/groups/roles; > break-glass = Partial.

tenantChecks.title: Legacy authentication is blocked
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: enabled, All users, All apps, clientAppTypes contains exchangeActiveSync and other, grant block.
tenantChecks.notes: Also query sign-in logs for legacy auth successes as evidence (AuditLog.Read.All).

tenantChecks.title: Admin sessions: sign-in frequency and no persistent browser
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: admin-scoped policy with sessionControls.signInFrequency (isEnabled, value <= 4 hours) and persistentBrowser.mode = never.
tenantChecks.expected: Both session controls present for admins

tenantChecks.title: High user risk requires MFA and password change
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: userRiskLevels contains high, grant mfa + passwordChange (AND) or riskRemediation.
tenantChecks.notes: No P2 = N/A with note.

tenantChecks.title: Risky sign-ins require MFA or are blocked
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: signInRiskLevels contains high (and medium), grant mfa or block.

tenantChecks.title: Managed device required for access
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: All users, All apps, grant compliantDevice and/or domainJoinedDevice.
tenantChecks.notes: Policies limited to some platforms or client app types = Partial; list the gaps.

tenantChecks.title: Managed device required to register security info
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: includeUserActions contains urn:user:registersecurityinfo, grant compliantDevice/domainJoinedDevice.

tenantChecks.title: Intune enrollment requires sign-in every time
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: includeApplications contains d4ebce55-015a-49b5-a083-c84d1797ae8c (Microsoft Intune Enrollment), signInFrequency.frequencyInterval = everyTime.

tenantChecks.title: Device code flow is blocked
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: conditions.authenticationFlows.transferMethods contains deviceCodeFlow, grant block, All users.
tenantChecks.notes: Sign-in success from a blocked flow is NOT proof; only the policy counts.

tenantChecks.title: Sign-in frequency is set for all users
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: All users, signInFrequency isEnabled (any value; CIS gives guidance).

tenantChecks.title: Authentication transfer is blocked
tenantChecks.rule: CA engine: conditions.authenticationFlows.transferMethods contains authenticationTransfer, grant block.

tenantChecks.title: Authenticator shows app name and location
tenantChecks.notes: Number matching is enforced by Microsoft; do not test it.

tenantChecks.title: Custom banned password list is enforced
tenantChecks.rule: Settings object from template 5cf42378-d67d-4f36-ba46-e8b86229381d (Password Rule Settings): EnableBannedPasswordCheck, BannedPasswordList
tenantChecks.notes: No settings object = defaults = Fail.

tenantChecks.title: Password protection is enforced on-premises
tenantChecks.rule: Password Rule Settings: EnableBannedPasswordCheckOnPremises and BannedPasswordCheckOnPremisesMode

tenantChecks.title: All member users are MFA capable
tenantChecks.notes: Show count + downloadable list of non-capable users.

tenantChecks.title: SMS and voice sign-in are disabled
System-preferred MFA is enabled
Smart lockout threshold is 10 or less
Smart lockout duration is 60 seconds or more
Authenticator Lite (companion app) is disabled
Self-service password reset is enabled for all
tenantChecks.rule: SSPR scope is not exposed via Graph.

tenantChecks.title: SSPR registration is required and reconfirmed
tenantChecks.expected: Registration required at sign-in, reconfirm <= 180 days

tenantChecks.title: Users are notified of password resets
tenantChecks.expected: Notify users on password reset = Yes

tenantChecks.title: Admins are notified of admin password resets
Guest access is reviewed regularly
tenantChecks.rule: Definitions whose scope targets guest users (query contains userType eq 'Guest').

tenantChecks.title: Privileged role assignments are reviewed
tenantChecks.rule: Definitions scoped to directory role assignments (roleAssignmentScheduleInstances).

tenantChecks.title: Global Administrator activation needs approval
graph: GET /v1.0/policies/roleManagementPolicyAssignments?$filter=scopeId eq '/' and scopeType eq 'DirectoryRole' and roleDefinitionId eq '62e90394-69f5-4237-9190-012177145e10'&$expand=policy($expand=rules)
tenantChecks.notes: Authentication context on activation is good but is NOT approval.

tenantChecks.title: Privileged Role Administrator activation needs approval
graph: GET /v1.0/policies/roleManagementPolicyAssignments?$filter=scopeId eq '/' and scopeType eq 'DirectoryRole' and roleDefinitionId eq 'e8611ab8-c189-46e8-94e1-60213ab1f814'&$expand=policy($expand=rules)
